what: Phase 2 complete: community labels and surprising connections
why: P5 labels each community by its most central node; P8 surfaces cross-community bridges ranked by surprise score
learned: Community labels reduce cognitive load for AI agents by replacing numeric IDs with meaningful names. Surprising connections help identify unexpected architectural bridges.
author: Mario Sandoval (Sv Tech)
impact: All 36 tests pass. Three existing MCP tools now show community labels; one new tool (sv_graph_surprising_connections) added. Fixed a double-computation bug in DetectCommunityLabels.
next_steps: Review and commit Phase 2 changes. Consider: exporting labels to graph sync, adding relation judgment between memories, and Phase 3 (confidence rules / P9-P10).
